title: Aaj raat Night Owl
caption:
Agar aaj raat aap apna naam khud chunte, to kya rakhte? 👇
Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a young man who picks his own name and avatar for the evening in Waypoint, an anonymous peer-support space for adults 18 and over.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Arjun: Arjun is a quiet young man in his twenties with short black hair, round glasses and a grey hoodie.
cast.Maa: Maa is Arjun's mother, a kind woman in her fifties in a printed cotton saree.

scenes.vo: रात के ग्यारह बजे थे, अर्जुन जाग रहा था।
scenes.sub: Raat ke gyaarah baje the, Arjun jaag raha tha.
scenes.art: Arjun sitting on his bed in a dim room at night, phone glowing in his hands, a desk lamp, city lights through the window.

scenes.vo: दिन भर की बातें मन में घूम रही थीं।
scenes.sub: Din bhar ki baatein man mein ghoom rahi thi.
scenes.art: Arjun lying back on pillows staring at the ceiling, faint thought-swirl of warm light, quiet night.

scenes.vo: वो कुछ कहना चाहता था, बिना नाम बताए।
scenes.sub: Woh kuch kehna chahta tha, bina naam bataye.
scenes.art: Arjun holding his phone, hesitating with a thumb above the screen, soft lamp light on his face.

scenes.vo: वेपॉइंट पर रोज़ एक नया नाम मिलता है।
scenes.sub: Waypoint par roz ek naya naam milta hai.
scenes.art: Arjun looking at his phone with a small curious smile, the lamp casting a warm circle.

scenes.vo: पर आज उसने ख़ुद अपना नाम चुना।
scenes.sub: Par aaj usne khud apna naam chuna.

scenes.vo: बीस अक्षर तक, और एक इमोजी।
scenes.sub: Bees akshar tak, aur ek emoji.

scenes.vo: नाम रखा, नाइट आउल। उल्लू वाला अवतार।
scenes.sub: Naam rakha, Night Owl. Ullu wala avatar.
scenes.art: Arjun grinning softly at his phone, a small friendly owl illustration glowing above the phone as a floating icon.

scenes.vo: चौबीस घंटे के लिए, यही उसकी पहचान थी।
scenes.sub: Chaubees ghante ke liye, yahi uski pehchaan thi.
scenes.art: Arjun's phone on the desk showing a calm glow, a clock on the wall showing midnight, peaceful room.

scenes.vo: उसने अपने मन की एक बात लिख दी।
scenes.sub: Usne apne man ki ek baat likh di.
scenes.art: Arjun typing on his phone with relaxed shoulders, a cup of water beside him.

scenes.vo: किसी ने जवाब दिया, तुम अकेले नहीं हो।
scenes.sub: Kisi ne jawab diya, tum akele nahi ho.
scenes.art: Arjun reading a reply on his phone with a soft relieved smile, early light starting at the window.

scenes.vo: आज रात आप कौन सा नाम चुनते?
scenes.sub: Aaj raat aap kaun sa naam chunte?
scenes.art: Close-up of Arjun smiling gently at the viewer, hoodie, night window softly blurred behind.
